text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Isn't that person over there
the one everyone's talking about on TV, y'know――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew~ Thanks for the meal♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer!
I never expected to bump into you right now.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Actually, I have a major job coming up, so I came to fire myself up with a delicious meal.
choice_data_list: Your success just keeps growing, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all!
I still have my hands full just dealing with what's in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'm still far from my ideal. ...Everyone just keeps pulling further and further ahead of me.
choice_data_list: The ideal comes first, you say?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu♪ I should get going soon.
Thank you so much for chatting with me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer, if you're free tonight,
please tune in to the TV at 7:00 PM!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's almost 7:00 PM.
Following Light Hello's instructions, I turned on the TV and――

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
"――She has only one thing on her mind.
She wants to make the Umamusume... shine."

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume Continent――Tonight's featured protagonist is...
none other than the acclaimed ace event producer herself."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hurry with load-in! Costume crew, stand by in the wings!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Let us stay sharp for rehearsals as well. It is our passion that brings brilliance to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
"Immediately upon returning to the office, she dives into another meeting.
Without a moment to catch her breath, not a hint of fatigue shows on her face."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about this compromise?
We set up dedicated cameras for each person and stream it online.

text_block_list.name: Meeting Partner
text_block_list.text: I see, providing added value distinct from the live venue... That's an intriguing angle.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
"In high demand for her brilliant talent.
One might think she works tirelessly without a day off, but――"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I make sure to take proper days off too!
I've gone to amusement parks and art museums, after all.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break is important, you know!
You can come up with project ideas you'd never think of while working♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
"――Passion. An innate keen eye for observation.
And even rest itself... is a weapon in her arsenal."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
. ...Though, this isn't something
I discovered all on my own—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
For about three years, I've watched a certain Trainer.
Someone who always looks ahead, never once coming to a standstill.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still... whenever I felt like collapsing,
you turned around and took my hand.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You called my ordinary qualities 'talent,'
and taught me how to take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If I had never met them...
I would have given up on my dream.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: That is why I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I won't just hold out my hand.
I want to run shoulder to shoulder with you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Well... Meanwhile, she just keeps succeeding and drifting further and further out of reach. Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still, I will definitely build up my track record and catch up.
That is my goal—and my ideal.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: So, let's head right over to our next job!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
In order to catch up to that back,
there's no time for me to stand still!
